description
String detailing what changed, either as free-form text or serialized
When the description contains JSON it may be either a serialized o
serialized array of objects. Each key in the object(s) corresponds to
property that was changed. This JSON is intended only to summar
change, not to be de-serialized.
The first example below is for a "user_update" action. The object th
changed was a user whose Duo username is "jsmith". The change s
values for the user's "notes" and "realname" fields, overwriting the
values if any were set. They correspond to the similarly named field
Modify User call in the Admin API and the User Details page in the
Admin Panel.
The second example shows an "admin_login_error" action. The
administrator's login attempt failed because the admin attempted t
SSO but, as indicated by the "error" in the description, SAML login
disabled for administrators on that account.
isotimestamp
ISO8601 timestamp of the event.
object
The object that was acted on. For example: "jsmith" (for users), "(55
6275 x456" (for phones), or "HOTP 8-digit 123456" (for tokens).
timestamp
An integer indicating the Unix timestamp of the event.
username
The full name of the administrator who performed the action in the
Admin Panel. If the action was performed with the API this will be "
Automatic actions like deletion of inactive users have "System" for
username. Changes synchronized from Directory Sync will have a u
of the form (example) "AD Sync: name of directory."
